verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana Ọrovwohwo da ta kẹ Ebram, Yanran nẹ orho wẹn kugbe ekru wẹn kugbe uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ wẹn vwo kpo otọ ri mi che dje kẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana orovwohwo da ta ke ebram yanran ne orho wen kugbe ekru wen kugbe uwevwi re ose wen vwo kpo oto ri mi che dje ke we

verses.text_urhobo: Ki mi ru we vwọ dia ẹgborho buebu, ki mi bruphihọ kẹ wẹ, ki mi ru odẹ wẹn rho, eriyin na ku wọ dia ebruphihọ.
verses.text_romanized: ki mi ru we vwo dia egborho buebu ki mi bruphiho ke we ki mi ru ode wen rho eriyin na ku wo dia ebruphiho

verses.text_urhobo: Ki mi bruba kẹ ihwo ri bruba kẹ wẹ, oro harhe owẹ ke Me harhọ; vwẹ oma wẹn irere rẹ akpọ na ejobi de vwo ebruphihọ kẹ oma rayen.
verses.text_romanized: ki mi bruba ke ihwo ri bruba ke we oro harhe owe ke me harho vwe oma wen irere re akpo na ejobi de vwo ebruphiho ke oma rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Ebram da yanran, kirobo rẹ Ọrovwohwo ta kẹ, Lọt vẹ ọye da yan usun. Ebram da dia ikpe ujorha gbẹ ihwiori vwẹ ọke ro vwo vrẹn ni Haran.
verses.text_romanized: koye ebram da yanran kirobo re orovwohwo ta ke lot ve oye da yan usun ebram da dia ikpe ujorha gbe ihwiori vwe oke ro vwo vren ni haran

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram da reyọ Serai rẹ aye rọye, kugbe Lọt rẹ ọmọ rẹ oniọvo. rọye, kugbe ekuakua ri rhere ejobi, kugbe ihwo ro vwori vwi Haran, ayen vwo te otọ ri Kenan nu. Ọke rẹ ayen vwo te otọ ri Kenan,
verses.text_romanized: ebram da reyo serai re aye roye kugbe lot re omo re oniovo roye kugbe ekuakua ri rhere ejobi kugbe ihwo ro vwori vwi haran ayen vwo te oto ri kenan nu oke re ayen vwo te oto ri kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram de ki otọ na re te asan re se Shikẹm, re te ọhahe ri Morẹh. Vwẹ ọke yena yẹ ihwo ri Kenan ji otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: ebram de ki oto na re te asan re se shikem re te ohahe ri moreh vwe oke yena ye ihwo ri kenan ji oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ Ebram, ọ da ta, Uvwiẹ wẹn Me cha vwẹ otọ nana kẹ. O da so agbada kẹ Ọrovwohwo rọ vwẹ oma phia kẹ, vwẹ Etiyin na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin orovwohwo da vwe oma phia ke ebram o da ta uvwie wen me cha vwe oto nana ke o da so agbada ke orovwohwo ro vwe oma phia ke vwe etiyin na

verses.text_urhobo: O de vrẹn nẹ Etiyin vwo kpo enu rẹ ugbenu rọ obọrhe ri Bẹtẹl, ọ da bọn utughẹ rọye, yi Bẹtẹl obọhwere, Ai da rha obọrhe; Etiyin ọ da so agbada kẹ Ọrovwohwo o de se odẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo na.
verses.text_romanized: o de vren ne etiyin vwo kpo enu re ugbenu ro oborhe ri betel o da bon utughe roye yi betel obohwere ai da rha oborhe etiyin o da so agbada ke orovwohwo o de se ode re orovwohwo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ebram da rhoma mu oyan họ ọ da garo vi obi Nẹgẹb.
verses.text_romanized: ebram da rhoma mu oyan ho o da garo vi obi negeb

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke nana owẹvwe de rhi fi vwẹ otọ na. Etiyin Ebram de kpo Ijipt ra dia fikiridie owẹvwe na firi gangan vwẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana owevwe de rhi fi vwe oto na etiyin ebram de kpo ijipt ra dia fikiridie owevwe na firi gangan vwe oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ro che vwo te otọ rẹ Ijipt re, ọ da ta kẹ Serai rẹ aye rọye, Me riẹnre nẹ wẹ aye vẹ erhuvwu siẹ re de ni we.
verses.text_romanized: oke ro che vwo te oto re ijipt re o da ta ke serai re aye roye me rienre ne we aye ve erhuvwu sie re de ni we

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ihwo rẹ Ijipt da rhe mrẹ wẹ, kẹ ayen cha tanẹ, Ọnana aye rọye, kẹ ayen che hwe vwe, ayen ki ju we vwo.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ihwo re ijipt da rhe mre we ke ayen cha tane onana aye roye ke ayen che hwe vwe ayen ki ju we vwo

verses.text_urhobo: Gba ta kẹ ayen nẹ wẹ oniọvo mẹ, rere o vwo yovwi kẹ vwẹ fiki wẹ, rere Me mrasan rhọ fiki wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: gba ta ke ayen ne we oniovo me rere o vwo yovwi ke vwe fiki we rere me mrasan rho fiki we

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Ebram vwo te Ijipt re, ihwo rẹ Ijipt da mrẹ aye na nẹ oyovwiri gangan.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ebram vwo te ijipt re ihwo re ijipt da mre aye na ne oyovwiri gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ emọ rẹ ovie Fero, vwọ mrẹ, ayen de jiro ki Fero. A da reyọ aye na vwo rhe Fero.
verses.text_romanized: re emo re ovie fero vwo mre ayen de jiro ki fero a da reyo aye na vwo rhe fero

verses.text_urhobo: Vwi fiki rọye ọ da nabọ vwẹ ẹro te Ebram, o de vwo igegede, irhuẹn, ekẹtẹkẹtẹ rẹ eshare kugbe erẹ eya, idibo rẹ eshare kugbe emetẹ, kugbe kamẹl.
verses.text_romanized: vwi fiki roye o da nabo vwe ero te ebram o de vwo igegede irhuen eketekete re eshare kugbe ere eya idibo re eshare kugbe emete kugbe kamel

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ emiavwe mu Fero kugbe =uwevwi rọye ejobi fiki Serai aye rẹ Ebram.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da vwe emiavwe mu fero kugbe uwevwi roye ejobi fiki serai aye re ebram

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Fero de se Ebram, ọ da ta, Ọnana die wo ru kẹ vwẹ na? Kidie wọ gbe ta kẹ vwẹ nẹ aye wẹ-ẹn?
verses.text_romanized: etiyin fero de se ebram o da ta onana die wo ru ke vwe na kidie wo gbe ta ke vwe ne aye we en

verses.text_urhobo: Die wọ vwọ tanẹ oniọvo mẹ? rọ da nẹrhẹ ovwẹ reyọ vwo ru aye? Nighe aye wẹn na, reyọ ru wọ yanran.
verses.text_romanized: die wo vwo tane oniovo me ro da nerhe ovwe reyo vwo ru aye nighe aye wen na reyo ru wo yanran

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da kpokpa kẹ ihwo rọye kpahe Ebram, ayen de suo ro ughere, te aye rọye kugbe ihwo ro vwori ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: fero da kpokpa ke ihwo roye kpahe ebram ayen de suo ro ughere te aye roye kugbe ihwo ro vwori ejobi
